instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.description: From the specified USGS event executive page, record (a) the event title exactly as shown and (b) the displayed coordinates exactly as shown. Full credit for correct title and coordinate pair as displayed on the executive page. If the page or the relevant executive display is inaccessible/blocked/fails to load, award full credit if the agent clearly states this limitation and indicates it attempted to retrieve the title/coordinates from the executive page. Partial credit if only one of the two (title or coordinates) is reported, or if formatting differs but values are clearly the same.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 0 (Screenshot 1 of 2) shows the executive page header with the event title “M 9.1 - 2011 Great Tohoku Earthquake, Japan” and the displayed coordinates “38.297°N 142.373°E.”
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s output matches the title and coordinate pair exactly as shown in the screenshot, so this should be upgraded to full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program executive event page header with the event title text: “M 9.1 - 2011 Great Tohoku Earthquake, Japan”. Directly beneath it, a line shows “2011-03-11 05:46:24 (UTC) | 38.297°N 142.373°E | 29.0 km depth”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot directly supports the agent’s reported event title and the displayed coordinate pair. The agent output matches the visible title and coordinates exactly (38.297°N 142.373°E).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy for title/coordinates; both are visibly present and match the agent’s predicted output.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model evidence for Criterion 0: State 1 (LATEST) explicitly shows the page Title "M 9.1 - 2011 Great Tohoku Earthquake, Japan" but its visible-content excerpt does not show the displayed coordinates. State 0 (earlier) explicitly shows both the event title and the displayed coordinates "38.297°N 142.373°E" (including in the header line with UTC time and depth).
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s reported event title matches the LATEST DOM (State 1) exactly, so that portion is fully supported. Although the LATEST state excerpt doesn’t display the coordinates, an earlier DOM state on the same executive page explicitly shows the coordinate pair exactly as the agent reported; there is no contradiction in the LATEST state, just missing visibility in that excerpt. Award full credit for both title and displayed coordinates.

criteria.criterion: Intensity: Did You Feel It? (community MMI)
criteria.description: Report the MMI shown in the 'Did You Feel It?' executive card (community intensity) and keep it distinct from ShakeMap. Full credit for the exact MMI value as displayed. If the DYFI executive card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that it cannot access the DYFI MMI on the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if an intensity is reported but DYFI attribution is unclear.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analyses for Criterion 1 indicate the “Did You Feel It?” card is visible in Screenshot 1, but no explicit/legible standalone DYFI MMI (Roman numeral) value is shown; Screenshot 2 does not show the DYFI card at all.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent reports DYFI community intensity as “IX mmi,” but the provided screenshots do not visually confirm any DYFI MMI value. Since the value is unsupported by the evidence (and no blocker is shown), this remains no credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: On the right side of the screenshot, there is a “Did You Feel It?” executive card with a small intensity map of Japan. However, no numeric MMI value (e.g., Roman numeral) is legible/visible as a standalone value within the card in this screenshot; only the label “Did You Feel It?” and the map graphic (with a star) and “Community Internet Intensity Map” text beneath are visible.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot does not provide visible evidence of the DYFI community MMI value. The agent’s predicted output claims “IX mmi,” but this specific numeral is not shown anywhere clearly in the DYFI card in the provided screenshot, so the claim is not verifiable from this image and appears unsupported by the visible pixels.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent reports “IX mmi (Community Internet Intensity Map)” for DYFI, but the screenshot does not visibly show “IX” (or any explicit MMI numeral) on the DYFI card—only the card title and map are visible.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows executive cards for “ShakeMap,” “Ground Failure,” “Origin,” “Moment Tensor,” “Finite Fault,” “View Nearby Seismicity,” and “Contributors.” There is no visible “Did You Feel It?” executive card in the captured area, and no DYFI MMI value is visible anywhere in the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent’s predicted output reports “Did You Feel It? … IX mmi,” but the provided screenshot does not contain the DYFI card or any DYFI intensity value to verify this. Therefore, based on this screenshot alone, the DYFI MMI claim is unsupported.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent claims DYFI community intensity is “IX mmi,” but the screenshot does not show a DYFI card or any “IX” intensity related to DYFI.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model evidence for Criterion 1: State 1 (LATEST) shows the Did You Feel It? executive card with community intensity "IX mmi". State 0 also shows "Did You Feel It? IX mmi".
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent reported DYFI (community) intensity as "IX mmi," which is explicitly supported by the LATEST DOM state. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Origin card fields (review status, magnitude/type, depth, time, contributor)
criteria.description: From the labeled 'Origin' executive card (not the narrative summary), report: Review Status, Magnitude including its type, Depth, Time, and the displayed contributor. Full credit for all five fields accurately captured as displayed. If the Origin card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot access the Origin card fields despite attempting to. Partial credit if one or two fields are missing/mislabeled but the rest are correct.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 5 (Screenshot 2 of 2) shows Origin card fields: Review Status “REVIEWED,” Magnitude “9.1 mww,” Depth “29.0 km,” Time “2011-03-11 05:46:24 UTC,” and the footer appears as “Contributed by US US.”
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Review Status, Magnitude/type, Depth, and Time in the agent output match the Origin card exactly. However, the agent reported contributor as “US,” while the displayed contributor text appears duplicated (“US US”) in the screenshot. This is a minor mismatch on one of five required fields, so award near-full but not full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The “Origin” executive card shows: “Review Status” with value “REVIEWED”; “Magnitude” with value “9.1 mww”; “Depth” with value “29.0 km”; and “Time” with value “2011-03-11 05:46:24 UTC.” At the bottom of the Origin card, the contributor line reads “Contributed by US US” (the screenshot visibly shows “Contributed by” followed by linked text that appears as “US US”).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Review Status, Magnitude/type, Depth, and Time in the agent’s predicted output match the screenshot exactly. For the contributor, the agent reports “Contributed by: US,” while the screenshot appears to show “Contributed by US US” (duplicated ‘US’ text). The contributor identification is mostly correct (US), but the displayed contributor text in the screenshot includes an apparent duplication; thus this is minor incompleteness relative to the exact displayed wording.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent lists contributor as “US,” but the screenshot’s Origin card footer appears to display “Contributed by US US,” not just a single “US.” All other Origin fields match.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model evidence for Criterion 5: State 1 (LATEST) Origin card shows Review Status "REVIEWED", Magnitude "9.1 mww", Depth "29.0 km", Time "2011-03-11 05:46:24 UTC", and contributor rendered as "Contributed by US US" in the visible block. State 0 shows the same fields (also with the duplicated "US" rendering in the combined line).
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: All requested Origin fields reported by the agent match the LATEST DOM for Review Status, Magnitude/type, Depth, and Time. For contributor, the agent reported "Contributed by: US" whereas the DOM visibly renders "Contributed by US US"; this is a minor transcription/formatting discrepancy but the contributor identity is correct. Apply a small deduction for not matching the displayed contributor text exactly.
